items.title: Globe Life (GL) Stock Could Be Undervalued On Its Earnings Strength
items.summary: Globe Life has delivered a strong share price run over the past few years, and the stock now trades at a level that prompts a closer look at what investors are paying for its earnings. The key issue is whether the current valuation fairly reflects the durability and quality of those profits. Over 5 years the stock has gained 82.7%, which raises the question of how much of that move is supported by the insurer's earnings power rather than sentiment.
